# Labels

Create these labels in the repository settings. The issue forms apply some of them automatically.

| Label | Use |
|---|---|
| `product:umg` | Handoff for UMG (Widget Blueprints) |
| `product:slate` | Handoff for Slate (Slate C++ generation) |
| `product:exporter` | The shared Figma exporter or other exporters |
| `bug` | Something does not work as documented |
| `import` | First import, layout, textures or images, text, preview |
| `reimport` | Re-import, merge, conflicts, re-link, backup and restore |
| `fonts` | Font mapping, Google Fonts download, text styles, resources and packaging |
| `commonui` | UMG: CommonUI mode, input actions, button and text styles |
| `codegen` | Slate: generated code shape, names, compile errors in generated files |
| `exporter` | The Figma exporter or other exporters |
| `setup` | Installation, health checks, settings, engine version, plugin or module dependencies |
| `needs-bundle` | Waiting for a support bundle (applied by the forms; removed once attached) |
| `confirmed` | Reproduced by the maintainer |
| `fixed-in-next` | Fixed and will ship in the next release |
| `enhancement` | Feature request (GitHub default label; applied by the feature form) |

Apply one `product:*` label to every issue (the forms' **Product** answer tells which).
